catalog-frontend-logger.why: The browser-writable frontend logger is never trusted (B3-X1)

catalog-unreachable-rule.why: A trusted-only rule whose templates aren't in the catalog can never fire

counts-wrong.why: Manifest counts must match the contents

duplicate-json-key.why: Duplicate keys: a reviewer and the loader could read different values

engine-api-overstated.why: Manifest must state exactly what the rules need

kind-mismatch.why: A rule file declared as a catalog

lifetime-too-long.why: Expiry more than 366 days after creation

rule-misfiled.why: Same rule id twice, one in a file not named after it

rule-with-code.why: One refused rule refuses the whole pack (E2 §6)

suppression-cycle.why: llm suppresses P-4 and P-4 suppresses llm: two faults hide each other

suppression-unknown-rule.why: A rule selector must name a rule in the pack

tampered-byte.why: A byte changed after the manifest was written (lane 2 -> 1)

unlisted-file.why: A file the manifest doesn't list
